// CASE dart_closure_param_shadow expect=pass
Future<void> closureParam(List<int> items) async {
  final width = 1;
  await probe(width);
  await run(items, (List<int> items, int width) async {
    await mapWithConcurrency(items, width, save);
  });
}
// CASE dart_record_destructure expect=pass
Future<void> recordDestructure(List<int> items, Config config) async {
  final width = 1;
  await probe(width);
  if (config.parallel) {
    final (w, retries) = config.parsed();
    await mapWithConcurrency(items, w, save);
  }
}
// CASE end expect=pass
